title: Add unit tests for relay server, RelayClient, audio codec, and UI helpers
summary:
Introduced a Vitest-based test suite covering the whole app's testable logic (not just the server, per revised request).

Refactors (behavior-preserving):
- server/server.js: extracted `startServer`/`stopServer` lifecycle + `attachRelay`, guarded auto-start via main-module check, and exported handlers/maps so tests drive the real server.
- src/audio.js: moved pure PCM conversion (float32↔int16) and the noise gate into a new src/audio-codec.js; audio.js now uses `createNoiseGate()` + imported codec helpers.
- src/main.js: moved pure UI helpers (escHtml, relativeTime, formatKeybind, id generators, contact storage) into a new src/util.js and imports them.

Tests added:
- server/__tests__/server.test.js: full protocol integration via real `ws` clients (register/id-taken, token, call/accept/reject/cancel/hangup/busy/peer-unavailable/self-call, mute, ping, audio forwarding, reconnect grace).
- server/__tests__/token.test.js: RELAY_TOKEN gating via a fresh module instance.
- src/__tests__/relay.test.js: RelayClient event routing, command payloads, binary audio, reconnect scheduling (mock WebSocket, jsdom).
- src/__tests__/audio-codec.test.js: PCM codec clamping/round-trip + noise-gate hysteresis/attack/reset.
- src/__tests__/util.test.js: escaping, relative time, keybind formatting, id uniqueness, contact CRUD (jsdom + injected store).

Tooling: added vitest + jsdom devDeps and a `test` script at repo root; added vitest.config.js.
userVisibleChange: `npm test` now runs 55 unit/integration tests across the relay server and client logic.
